{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ruebeqni''' were a group one [[Gender/Legends|matron]] of which was present aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]''.<ref name="Insider144">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ruebeqni appeared in [[Jason Fry]]'s short story "[[Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 144|144th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider144" /> on [[September 3]], [[2013]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]</ref> In the short story, a pull quote of the passage mentioning the Ruebeqni misspelled their name as the "Rhuebequni."<ref name="Insider144" /> The "Rubeqni" spelling was confirmed in the version of the story republished in ''[[Star Wars Insider: The Fiction Collection Volume 2]]''.<ref name="Fiction2">''[[Star Wars Insider: The Fiction Collection Volume 2]]''</ref>
